title: ArcCivs V7: one finite lower mine floor; native items separate from currency
assumptions: One existing quarry owner in each low/base/high scenario; 0/1/3 extra floor completions in the first active day. This is a bounded scenario, not telemetry.

A mine has three supported building levels. V7 appends one distinct floor per level, so at most three additional floors over the lifetime of one quarry; the weekly cap below is this one-quarry lifetime bound, not a recurring quota.

The modeled native material is plain STONE with one COBBLESTONE per actual native drop; 990 distinct planned AIR cuts plus up to four additional native ladder-cell clearance cuts yield 994 COBBLESTONE per added floor in this model. Of 410 planned COBBLESTONE placements, four sound backing walls can remain native; the other 406 modeled placements consume and return one COBBLESTONE each, net zero under the same drop assumption.
An AIR/cave column may yield zero and consume support material. Native ore composition and tool-dependent drops can differ; no ore price, SELL price, contract value or measured income is invented.
Each extra full floor plans four ladders, 50 torches, 16 timber fences, 48 logs and 81 planks. Exact live safety repairs and tool wear are additional existing native costs, not a free supply.

Autonomous native scenery grants zero real items and consumes zero ordinary resident items. Existing canonical production, its costs, stock and cadence are unchanged. Direct player XP is a separate zero-delta flow; resident progression is not player XP.
Direct Vault, premium-token and player-XP flows are separately zero before and after. The 2000ms ordinary action, 6000ms generator and 95/4/1 generator item distribution are unchanged.

The existing repeatable generator remains a separate existing flow and is not counted as finite new floor output. Current EconomyShopGUI SELL and the planned SELL-to-contract transition are unchanged alternative downstream monetization; no double counting.

Owner-authorized lava clearance removes one existing LAVA cell inside planned mine positions through a securing-mine receipt: zero inputs, outputs and equipment changes; no excavation cursor credit. WATER remains blocked. The following real STONE cut uses unchanged native drops; lava itself is never counted as stone.
